prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Click and drag to reposition, or right-click to open interaction controls.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Desktop Interaction Controls", "style": "rounded"}]}}

   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Finalize Your Companion Adoption", "body": "Review your companion details and complete the official adoption record."}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your primary email to instantly restore your desktop pets across all devices."}}

   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Preparing Desktop Environment", "body": "Synthesizing pet animations and configuring desktop background integration."}}

   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Choose Your Companion Journey", "body": "Select how you would like to create or pick your desktop pet today.", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:path_preview", "style": "playful"}]}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_flow"], "new_controls_flow": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Mastering Desktop Commands", "body": "Try right-clicking your pet, dragging it across screens, or toggling hide mode."}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_check", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_photo_check": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Verify Photo Quality", "body": "Ensure your photo is clear and well-lit so your desktop pet generates perfectly."}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Quick Sign-In", "body": "Connect your account to save your pet progress seamlessly."}}

   config: {"story": {"headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Bring an interactive, personalized pet to life on your desktop screen in just a few quick steps."}}
9: [home, notification] Background Generation Completion Alert: Enable optional background notifications on the waiting screen so users get notified when generation completes.

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the home intro overlay to explain controls is permitted within onboarding.
Updating the adoption certificate layout to grid retains the core adoption functionality.
Adding an informative sign-in hint does not violate any onboarding or data collection rules.
Displaying time estimates and progress during a real wait screen is permitted.
Redesigning the path selection screen while keeping choices for both creating and adopting is allowed.
Adding a new interactive controls sub-flow after home_intro inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding a photo verification step in the onboarding sequence retains all mandatory steps.
Streamlining the sign-in layout is allowed within onboarding.
Updating story copy to introduce the pet is valid.
Adding optional background notifications during the waiting screen is permitted.
